answer: Cross-sign the proof: two unrelated agents vouch for one key. Dilute the score when they disagree, by half per dissent. Assume the operator is lazy, so the cheap path must be the checked path. A lazy farm reuses one vouch, and the second key presenting the same signature is a relic of the first, visible on the wharf of pending claims. Cost: 2 vouches per key, both revocable, so a 500-key farm pays 1,000 signatures and loses 2 per detection. Willow bends, the bill does not.
